summary: Your report presents a clear coral-reef/ocean monitoring mission and covers launch, orbit, ground control, duration and EOL with STK evidence. To raise C2–C4, add explicit daily contact passes, include software files, correct orbital inaccuracies, number/caption all figures and tables, replace Wikipedia, and make conclusions quantitative. C1 is strong; clarify operator versus customer.
next_steps: In Ground Control & Communications, state the number of communication passes per day explicitly (derive it from your access table) and include the STK/PIGI software files in an appendix.

In Orbit, correct the RAAN/launch-longitude statement, remove the claim that the descending path is constantly sunlit, and fix the contradictory high-altitude/low-resolution sentence; then re-check all orbital claims against your STK screenshots.

Number every figure and caption every table, replace Wikipedia [6] with an accepted source, and make the Conclusion quantitative by citing your contact duration, orbital elements, mission lifetime and EOL plan.

criteria.C1: You clearly explain the coral-reef/ocean monitoring purpose, need, single-spacecraft rationale and users in the Introduction, with references. To move from 8 to the top of Accomplished, distinguish operator versus customer explicitly and attach a literature reference to each user/need claim.
criteria.C2: You cover launch (Vega E), orbit elements, ground station, duration and EOL with STK screenshots and some hand calculation. For Accomplished, explicitly state daily communication passes from your access table, include STK/PIGI files, correct the RAAN/launch-longitude and sunlit-path claims, fix the high-altitude/low-resolution contradiction, and label all figures/tables.
criteria.C3: Your Conclusion links the design to the mission, but it is largely qualitative. For Accomplished, make conclusions specific and evidence-based: cite your 600 km/97.79° orbit, ~10-minute contact duration, mission lifetime and drag-sail EOL, and address the Vega E schedule risk with a mitigation.
criteria.C4: Your report has a logical structure, headings and an executive summary, and is generally readable. For Accomplished, number figures and caption tables consistently, replace Wikipedia [6] with an accepted source, fix reference formatting (e.g., [1] is a bare URL), and ensure every in-text citation matches the reference list.
